explanation: The theorem says the stable elementary subgroup of the stable general linear group over a local ring equals the kernel of the determinant. It is stated for the library's own stable GL construction (stableElementarySubgroup, StableGL, exists_stage). Mathlib has no declarations with those names. Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Matrix/Transvection.lean and SpecialLinearGroup.lean cover transvections for finite matrices over fields or division rings, not the stable direct limit over a local ring. I found no Mathlib statement that gives this result.
